objective: Reproduce the reported keyboard focus problem
approach: Use synthetic inputs and the documented development environment. Record the smallest reproduction.
workflow: Follow CONTRIBUTING.md. Deliver reproduction steps as an issue comment; do not close the issue.
acceptance_criteria: Explain whether the reported behavior was reproduced
boundaries: No merging, deployment or changes to account settings
risk_notes: Repository scripts remain untrusted and may execute code. Check donor permissions before running them.
